name: daily_banking_pipeline
description: Daily banking and insurance analytics pipeline — replaces the SAS Control-M scheduled jobs (run_daily_banking.sas, claims_processing.sas, policy_valuation.sas, monthly_regulatory_reporting.sas, customer_profitability.sas). Executes dbt models in dependency order: staging → intermediate → marts → test. See docs/CICD_NARRATIVE.md for the full migration mapping from Control-M to Databricks Workflows.

tasks.description: Load and validate raw data into staging layer. Replaces SAS Step 1 (%run_step(1, Load Customer Accounts, load_customer_accounts.sas)), daily_transaction_processing.sas validation, and claims_processing.sas (Step 1: hash object policy lookup).
Run the stg_claims staging model. Ingests raw claims data and applies initial schema validation. Replaces claims_processing.sas Step 1 (hash object policy lookup and claim intake).

Run the int_claims_adjudication intermediate model. Applies fraud screening, auto-adjudication logic, and computes adjudication metrics. Replaces claims_processing.sas Steps 2-4 (fraud flag derivation, adjudication rules, SIU referral scoring).

Compute derived metrics and business logic. Replaces SAS Step 2 (DATA step computing ACCT_AGE_MONTHS, UTILIZATION_PCT, DORMANCY_FLAG), claims_processing.sas (Steps 2-4: fraud screening and adjudication), and policy_valuation.sas (Steps 1-4: premium, claims experience, reserves).

Build final analytical outputs. Replaces SAS Step 3 (credit_risk_scoring.sas), monthly_regulatory_reporting.sas (RWA and delinquency aging), policy_valuation.sas (Step 5: loss ratios), and customer_profitability.sas (Steps 1-4: P&L). Includes incremental transaction loading, risk scoring, anomaly detection, regulatory reporting, and insurance analytics.
Run all schema and data tests. SAS had no equivalent — QA was manual PROC PRINT/PROC SQL spot checks. dbt tests enforce data contracts declaratively after every run.
